description: Test cases for verifying algorithm correctness. Expected results are mathematically verified by manual trace.

test_cases.name: fifo_basic_verified
test_cases.description: FIFO trace: 3 frames, sequence [7,0,1,2,0,3,0,4,2,3,0,3,2,1,2,0,1,7,0,1]. Known result: 15 faults, 5 hits.

test_cases.name: lru_basic_verified
test_cases.description: LRU trace: 3 frames, same classic sequence. Known result: 12 faults, 8 hits.

test_cases.name: optimal_basic_verified
test_cases.description: Optimal trace: 3 frames, same classic sequence. Known result: 9 faults, 11 hits.

test_cases.name: all_hits
test_cases.description: All pages fit in memory. After initial loading, all remaining accesses are hits.

test_cases.name: all_faults
test_cases.description: Every page is unique. Every access is a fault regardless of algorithm.

test_cases.name: single_page_repeated
test_cases.description: Only one page, repeated. First access is a fault; all others are hits.

test_cases.name: one_frame
test_cases.description: Single frame. A hit occurs only when the same page is accessed consecutively.

test_cases.name: empty_sequence
test_cases.description: Empty page sequence. Should be rejected by validation, not passed to algorithms.

test_cases.name: zero_frames
test_cases.description: Zero frames. Should be rejected by validation.

test_cases.name: negative_frames
test_cases.description: Negative frame count. Should be rejected by validation.
